content: Decided by the owner on 2026-11-16: not a skill for now. Build, deploy and git rules stay in the repo's CLAUDE.md. One question stays open, raised by the owner: what handles Sanity and data issues. The session is comparing three options (no skill, a narrow data and CMS skill, the broad skill) and will report to him. Not decided as a skill. Its session is preparing a comparison: a skill, or the rules stay in the repo's [CLAUDE.md](http://CLAUDE.md). Nothing goes to development until the owner says. ## Skill card | Field | Value | | --- | --- | | Name | wugweb-web-engineering (proposed) | | Status | Not decided | | Planned in session | wugweb-web-engineering | ## What it would own How the site is built and shipped: Astro on Cloudflare Pages, the Sanity schema and queries, the Notion to Sanity sync scripts, R2 media rules, tests, build guards, preview and deploy, free-tier limits, the git workflow. It would also take Part 2 of the wugweb-work plan (parser, media manifest, sync, page components). ## What it would not own - What a page says or looks like. - Tokens and components (wugweb-kits). ## Rules already fixed - Never exceed any free tier. One R2 bucket, 9.5 GiB ceiling. - Sync scripts run dry by default, back up before writing, never write Notion, never delete. - No uploads or local copies of media. - Commits by path only, Wugweb trailer, changelog updated with every commit. - No secrets in the repo. ## Known defects it would fix first The case-study parser collapses 15 thin case studies into one section; 7 case studies with no body show another client's copy or placeholders; images are emitted without sizes; most videos have no poster. ## Helper skills cloudflare (wrangler, web-perf), sanity (content modelling, typegen), code-review, simplify, security-review, refactor. ## Coordinator's recommendation Do not make it a skill. Its rules already live in [CLAUDE.md](http://CLAUDE.md), which every session reads. Keep Part 2 as an ordinary build plan. ## Waiting on the owner - [ ] Read the session's comparison and decide: skill or no skill. - [ ] Replace the dead Notion and Cloudflare tokens. - [ ] Sign in to the Sanity and Cloudflare connectors.
